Stock Control Officer | DHL Supply Chain | Weert Are you accurate, analytical, and interested in logistics and inventory management? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as a Stock Control Officer and help keep our warehouse operations running smoothly. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring stock levels, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring that inventory information remains accurate and up to date. You will work closely with the warehouse team to investigate stock differences, improve inventory accuracy, and support efficient logistics processes. Whether you already have experience in stock control or are looking to develop your career in logistics, this role offers excellent opportunities to learn and grow. Wie zoeken we? Strong attention to detail and a structured, analytical approach. Good spoken and written English. An interest in logistics, stock control, or supply chain operations. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Previous experience in stock control or a similar position is an advantage but not required. A reliable, proactive, and independent working attitude. Wat bieden wij je? A gross hourly wage of €15.32. Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per working day. Annual salary increases in line with the applicable Collective Labour Agreement (CLA). Fully paid training and certifications, including EPT, OPT, forklift, and reach truck. Excellent opportunities for career development and internal growth. A stable full-time position with one of the world's leading logistics companies. Functieomschrijving Monitor stock levels and investigate inventory discrepancies. Carry out regular stock counts and cycle counts. Analyse differences between physical stock and system records and identify their causes. Keep inventory information accurate in the warehouse management system. Assist warehouse colleagues with stock-related questions and issues. Identify ways to improve inventory accuracy and streamline stock control processes. Ensure

inventory procedures are followed correctly and consistently.
